features.seq_Kr_alternation_rate: percentage of last K regimes that alternated direction
features.seq_Kr_mean_overlap: average overlap between adjacent prior regime price ranges
features.seq_Kr_mean_retracement: average retracement fraction of opposing regime pairs
features.seq_Kr_center_migration_slope_atr: OLS slope through completed regime center prices / atr
features.seq_Kr_position_pct: current price position inside the K-regime envelope (0=low, 1=high)
